evidence.reason: The assertion strips the first character from every encoded hunk line before comparing it with `text.splitlines()`. If a boundary line were emitted as ` third` instead of `+third`, `line[1:]` would still produce `third`, so the test would pass even though the required added-line prefix is wrong. This makes the test fail to verify the `+` prefix behavior its own comment describes. Compare the full encoded lines against expected `+`-prefixed lines instead.
